title: sec-overlay shared vocabularies (T2 parser/schema + T3 status/receipt) Implementation Plan
summary: Implementation plan defining shared receipt-tier and status vocabularies, gate contracts, schema changes, and TDD tasks for the sec-overlay plugin.
notes: Implementation plan, not a pure spec. Competing signals: prose plan/task structure (DOC) vs explicit interface contracts, frozenset vocabularies, JSON schema properties, and recorded rulings (SPEC). SPEC chosen per precedence rule (SPEC > DOC). Contains 'Ruling (recorded)' decisions (e.g. tree-sitter tier placement, tier-2 confirmation revocation) that are decision-like but embedded, not standalone ADRs. Filename hash segment is a stable slug-based token, not a computed SHA-256 (no shell available).
